rows.label: tlk42100152_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Hmph! In the end, the Superbian
research lab never managed to talk
with me.

rows.label: tlk42100152_05_msg0002
rows.name:
It's not like I'm disappointed
or anything! It was just too
predictable and boring!

rows.label: tlk42100152_05_msg0003
rows.name:
...But talking with you, I've started
to think that conversations with
humans aren't so bad after all.

rows.label: tlk42100152_05_msg0004
rows.name:
I still don't like being called a pet
fox, but I don't hate you.
